mapper.sql: id, user_id, question_id, stage, next_review_date, status, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_schedule (user_id, question_id, stage, next_review_date, status, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{stage}, #{nextReviewDate}, #{status}, #{completedAt})

INSERT INTO review_schedule (user_id, question_id, stage, next_review_date, status, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, 0, #{nextReviewDate}, 0, NULL) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stage = 0, next_review_date = incoming.next_review_date, status = 0, completed_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_schedule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM review_schedule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND next_review_date <= #{today} ORDER BY next_review_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE review_schedule SET stage = #{stage}, next_review_date = #{nextReviewDate}, status = #{status}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_schedule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_schedule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM review_schedule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage
